title: Sensei Governed Synthesis Attempt V1
description: One immutable, monotonically-appended attempt against one plan generation. Carries a proposed change-envelope digest, not an implicitly trusted mutation, and makes no admission or correctness claim.
$comment: Canonical producer/owner: globulario/sensei, golang/architecture/synthesis. produced_at is an observation timestamp explicitly excluded from attempt_digest_sha256 (zeroed before hashing, alongside the digest field itself) so attempt identity does not depend on wall-clock time, per the O1 hard law that timestamps and provider prose cannot influence authoritative transition identity unless explicitly included by contract.

attempt_number.$comment: Monotonically increasing within the session, starting at 1. Never reused, never decreased.

input_candidate_digest_sha256.$comment: Exact input candidate identity this attempt started from.

proposed_change_digest_sha256.$comment: Digest of the proposed patch/change-envelope. This is a reference to untrusted provider output, not a trusted mutation and not itself an admission request.
